purpose: Compile a verified chronological repair trajectory from the exact ledger into a typed procedure artifact, independently evaluate and publish it, reconstruct it after restart, and verify source/parent rejection, invalidation and rollback. CPU-only; no model training.

acceptance.accept_if: independent dev/heldout execution passes, publication succeeds, unseen restart execution succeeds, changed source is rejected, invalidation revokes the artifact, and rollback restores the parent
acceptance.reject_or_defer_if: any required check fails or evidence is missing

claims: Thin procedure compilation and publication only; no neural candidate, learned memory, self-improvement, generalization or personal fidelity claim.
retention: Keep ledger, source receipts, artifact catalog, active and ancestor manifests, restart receipts and the raw report. Use a fresh output directory.
